data.name: Better Stat Sticks
data.summary: Are you ever bothered by how if that item gave one more point in a stat, you'd have 1 more given to your rolls? Fear not! This mod changes odd numbered stat sticks to be even numbered. No more stocking strength pots when you can use that dandy club!

data.name: Better Hag Hair
data.summary: Instead of receiving an item, every player receives a skill which allows increasing an ability by +1. You can freely swap this bonus to a different ability at any time. Great for respecs and multiplayer.

data.name: Better_Origin_Shadowheart
data.summary: Shadowheart Origin improvement. ************* : New class. Nightbringers are Priest and Priestess of Shar. Anti-thesis of Warcraft priests, they can follow one of the 3 following path : Unholy, Discipline and Light. *Voidborn : New race.

modfile.changelog:
1. "The Blade Least Expected : Can no longer target the ground. Made this so it's more clear when you can cast it and when you cannot (it's the same condition as Sneak Attack). Since we now have Dagger Throw, it's no longer necessary for the Sneak Attack version to be able to be throw on the ground."
2. "Minor Shadowfiend : Summon only 1 doggo. The dog does not have the Shadow Blend passive anymore which should fix the timeouts. The Root Template is still buggy buggy but at least Invisibility and Jump should work better now."
3. "I cannot fix the surge of damage from Kushigo + Ring of Flinging. The wierd coding is from the items theimselves so it's gonna stay busted like this. I mean Rogue + College of Sword can already do similar damage not to mention Eldritch Blast, so i'm fine with it."

data.name: Better Plant Spike Growth
